decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The installation of one air conditioning unit to the roof of the building, as shown on drawing numbers M202, AL(0)205 & unnumbered, received 14 November 2006, would not harm the appearance of the building and street scene or the amenity of neighbours to the site. Therefore the proposed development complies with the London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003 policies ENV-B.1.1 New Development and ENV-P.1.5 Noise Pollution.
description: Installation of one air conditioning unit
